title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions — Terms on Overlapping Holdings and Other Allowances
content:
## 1. Combination by benefit type

1.1 Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions products a customer holds are combined by benefit type: a customer may not hold two subscriptions in purchased or active status that both cover bags or both cover seats, so a Seat and Bag Pass excludes any other subscription and a Bag Pass may be held only alongside a Seat Pass.

1.2 A subscription is not bought while the customer holds another subscription in purchased or active status covering the same benefit type.

1.3 The test in 1.2 is made on the company's records before the purchase is recorded: it looks at the subscriptions held under the same customer, their subscription names and their statuses as the records show them. What the customer says about their other subscriptions does not replace the records.

1.4 A subscription whose status is expired or cancelled is not in purchased or active status, and so does not enter the test in 1.2.

## 2. Pairs under clause 1 (derived from 1.1)

The Bag Passes cover bags, the Seat Passes cover seats, and the Seat and Bag Passes cover both.

| Held in purchased or active status | Proposed purchase | Same benefit type already held | Purchase under clause 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One or Two | Crestline Seat Pass Domestic or Network | No | Not barred |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic or Network | Crestline Bag Pass One or Two | No | Not barred |
| Crestline Bag Pass One or Two | Any other Bag Pass | Bags | Not bought |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic or Network | Any other Seat Pass | Seats | Not bought |
| Any subscription | Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic or Network | Bags, seats or both | Not bought |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic or Network | Any subscription | Bags, seats or both | Not bought |

## 3. Other allowances on the same trip

3.1 Subscription bags are compared with the fare brand, Summit elite and corporate allowances under the most-generous-allowance rule of the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand rules, and are never added to them, when the subscription's setting for adding its bags on top of the fare brand's free bags is No.

3.2 No part of the subscription price is refunded because another entitlement already covered the same bag or seat, when the subscription's setting for refunding part of the price because the Summit tier already includes the same benefit is No.

**Illustration of 3.1 (hypothetical allowances, setting No).** A traveler whose fare brand allows 1 free checked bag and whose subscription covers 2 bags in that direction does not receive 3 covered bags: the two allowances are compared under the most-generous-allowance rule, never added together.

**Illustration of 3.2 (hypothetical holder, setting No).** A holder whose Summit tier already covered the same bag on a trip receives no part of the subscription price back on that account.
